Advice from a harvest rate times a survey index

Source: R/hr_index.R
hr_index_advice.Rd

The rule of the Icelandic shrimp stocks (inshore and offshore northern shrimp): the advice is a fixed harvest rate (HR proxy) times the latest survey biomass index, with a biomass safeguard at I_trigger and no precautionary multiplier, optionally limited by a stability clause. chr_advice() can't be used: it applies the multiplier from K and stops when K < 0.32.

The published rule of the inshore shrimp stocks (Arnarfjordur, Isafjardardjup) is A = I x HR x b with the binary safeguard and no stability clause: safeguard = "binary" and the other defaults. The remaining options keep the old scripts' code reproducible, including leftover lines that are not the published method (October 2026: the stability-clause lines of the old Arnarfjordur and Isafjardardjup scripts, and their unapplied b), and their differences from the ICES rules:

safeguard

"ratio": b = min(1, I / I_trigger), ICES; "binary": b = 1 if I > I_trigger, otherwise 0 (Arnarfjordur, where I_trigger = I_lim); "none": b = min(1, I / I_trigger) is computed and shown but not applied.

apply_safeguard

TRUE (default) applies b; FALSE computes b as safeguard says and shows it, but doesn't apply it (the old Isafjardardjup and Snaefellsnes scripts: b binary, not applied).

safeguard_step

"initial": the initial advice is HR x I x b and the stability clause applies only when b = 1, as ICES; "final": the initial advice is HR x I and b multiplies the advice after the stability clause (Arnarfjordur).

stability_limits

NULL (default) for no stability clause, or the lower and upper multipliers of the previous advice, e.g. c(0.8, 1.2).

stability_threshold, stability_when

The clause is applied only when the relative change of the initial advice from the previous one, |A_initial / A_prev - 1|, is "above" the threshold (Isafjardardjup and Snaefellsnes: 0.5) or "below" it or equal (Arnarfjordur: 0.346, the HR proxy, which caps small changes only). With the default threshold 0 and "above" it always applies. With a previous advice of 0 the change is infinite (or undefined when the initial advice is also 0, and then the clause is not applied).

stability_set

FALSE (default): the clause bounds the advice between the limits; TRUE: when the clause applies, the advice is set to the upper limit if the initial advice is higher than the previous one and to the lower limit if it is lower, even if the change was smaller than the limits allow (the old Arnarfjordur and Isafjardardjup scripts; with their thresholds this only matters in Arnarfjordur, where changes under 20% are moved out to +/-20%).

change

The advice change in the table: "previous" 100 x (A / A_prev - 1), NA when the previous advice is 0 (undefined; the old Isafjardardjup script); "new" 100 x (1 - A_prev / A), with an infinite value shown as -100 (the old Arnarfjordur table).

Usage

hr_index_advice(
  index,
  prev_tac,
  hr_proxy,
  I_trigger,
  assessment_year,
  safeguard = c("ratio", "binary", "none"),
  apply_safeguard = TRUE,
  safeguard_step = c("initial", "final"),
  stability_limits = NULL,
  stability_threshold = 0,
  stability_when = c("above", "below"),
  stability_set = FALSE,
  change = c("previous", "new")
)

Arguments

index

A data frame with the columns year and index (see index_series()); years after the assessment year are left out, and the last index value is the one the advice is based on.

prev_tac

The previous catch advice.

hr_proxy

The harvest rate proxy (target HR).

I_trigger

The index trigger value (I_lim for the shrimp stocks).

assessment_year

The assessment year.

safeguard, apply_safeguard, safeguard_step, stability_limits, stability_threshold, stability_when, stability_set, change

See the description.

Value

A tibble with the columns component, value, type and assessment_year; the components previous_catch_advice, biomass_index, hr_proxy, I_trigger, biomass_safeguard, initial_catch_advice, stability_test (1 if the change passed the threshold test, NA if undefined), stability_clause_applied (1 if the clause changed the advice), catch_advice and advice_change.

Examples

idx <- data.frame(year = 2024:2026, index = c(489, 277, 717))
# Arnarfjordur 2026 as published: binary safeguard, no clause
hr_index_advice(idx, prev_tac = 0, hr_proxy = 0.346, I_trigger = 390,
  assessment_year = 2026, safeguard = "binary", change = "new")
#> # A tibble: 10 × 4
#>    component                  value type              assessment_year
#>    <chr>                      <dbl> <chr>                       <dbl>
#>  1 previous_catch_advice      0     advice                       2026
#>  2 biomass_index            717     biomass_index                2026
#>  3 hr_proxy                   0.346 harvest_rate                 2026
#>  4 I_trigger                390     biomass_safeguard            2026
#>  5 biomass_safeguard          1     biomass_safeguard            2026
#>  6 initial_catch_advice     248.    advice                       2026
#>  7 stability_test            NA     advice                       2026
#>  8 stability_clause_applied   0     advice                       2026
#>  9 catch_advice             248.    advice                       2026
#> 10 advice_change            100     advice                       2026
# The old advice/getData.R as written (with its leftover clause lines)
hr_index_advice(idx, prev_tac = 0, hr_proxy = 0.346, I_trigger = 390,
  assessment_year = 2026, safeguard = "binary", safeguard_step = "final",
  stability_limits = c(0.8, 1.2), stability_threshold = 0.346,
  stability_when = "below", stability_set = TRUE, change = "new")
#> # A tibble: 10 × 4
#>    component                  value type              assessment_year
#>    <chr>                      <dbl> <chr>                       <dbl>
#>  1 previous_catch_advice      0     advice                       2026
#>  2 biomass_index            717     biomass_index                2026
#>  3 hr_proxy                   0.346 harvest_rate                 2026
#>  4 I_trigger                390     biomass_safeguard            2026
#>  5 biomass_safeguard          1     biomass_safeguard            2026
#>  6 initial_catch_advice     248.    advice                       2026
#>  7 stability_test             0     advice                       2026
#>  8 stability_clause_applied   0     advice                       2026
#>  9 catch_advice             248.    advice                       2026
#> 10 advice_change            100     advice                       2026
# ICES-like: safeguard ratio, stability clause always
hr_index_advice(idx, prev_tac = 200, hr_proxy = 0.346, I_trigger = 390,
  assessment_year = 2026, stability_limits = c(0.8, 1.2))
#> # A tibble: 10 × 4
#>    component                  value type              assessment_year
#>    <chr>                      <dbl> <chr>                       <dbl>
#>  1 previous_catch_advice    200     advice                       2026
#>  2 biomass_index            717     biomass_index                2026
#>  3 hr_proxy                   0.346 harvest_rate                 2026
#>  4 I_trigger                390     biomass_safeguard            2026
#>  5 biomass_safeguard          1     biomass_safeguard            2026
#>  6 initial_catch_advice     248.    advice                       2026
#>  7 stability_test             1     advice                       2026
#>  8 stability_clause_applied   1     advice                       2026
#>  9 catch_advice             240     advice                       2026
#> 10 advice_change             20     advice                       2026
